children: On January 6, 2026, Scotiabank downgraded AST SpaceMobile to "Sell," citing competition from Starlink and evidence of slow user adoption in the United States and Japan.
Following this news, the price of AST SpaceMobile stock fell $11.76 per share, or 12.06%, to close at $85.73 per share on January 7, 2026.

On February 11, 2026, AST SpaceMobile announced and priced a $1 billion convertible notes offering. Following this news, the stock fell $14.70 per share, or 15.17%, to close at $82.22 per share on February 12, 2026.

On July 15, 2026, AST SpaceMobile announced and priced another $1 billion convertible senior notes offering. AST SpaceMobile disclosed that it intended to pursue potential partnerships or acquisitions but had no related understandings or agreements in place. Analysts at UBS and Roth Capital Partners questioned the financing given prior representations that its satellite constellation was fully funded. Following this news, the stock fell $11.30 per share, or 17.04%, to close at $55.01 per share on July 16, 2026.
